notes:
The leaderboard now ranks on everything you have earned since you started, not on this month alone. Every board in the app — your own on My Incentive, and the company one — shows the same five things: the name and SSL code, the department, the designation, the points you are holding now, and the points you have earned altogether. The month picker has gone from the boards, because both of those count from the beginning; it is still on My points, where the month is the whole question.

The points you are holding is what you have earned less whatever has already been settled with you, so the two figures part company the moment anything is paid.

Billing is now part of the same points. A new Billing Incentive tab reads the billing team's work straight out of the billing system — units, invoices, the band each person landed in and the points it earned them — and those points now count on the leaderboard, on the Points Dashboard and on My Incentive exactly like a day's rolling or a credit. Nothing about them is typed into the app, and nothing can be edited there: a figure that is wrong is wrong in the billing system and is corrected there. Anybody the app cannot match to an SSL code is listed on the tab with what their points are worth, so nobody's work quietly goes missing.

Billing points arrive once a month, for the whole month, because that is how the billing system settles — so on My points they read as a single row rather than day by day.

For everybody else nothing changes.
